title: Remove direct-SSH agent procedures: satellite work only through remote sessions, federation and Git branches
outcome: No agent procedure in this repository tells an agent to run commands on another machine by direct SSH. Work on a satellite goes through its remote TermAl sessions (mailbox GOs over federation) and Git branches (author-test or test refs). Greg's words, 2026-11-21, relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant in TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2153: „zakaz uzywania SSH, wlasnie to jest problem / pozniej tworzymy pierdolniete procedury / po to mamy remote sesje, po to mamy git branche aby tak pracowac / A NIE URUCHAMIAC SSH NA BOKU / JESTEM WSCIEKLY”. Scope, from the coordinator's read-only search at 61bb80ec+: AGENTS.md around line 457 ('Other commands that may prompt' lists ssh and scp with BatchMode tips; replace them with the ban and the federation route), and docs/test.md around line 143 ('An interactive or SSH shell can select a different executable', to be reworded for a remote runner session). The federation link's own internal OpenSSH transport (docs/features/satellite-onboarding.md, federation-link.md, project-scoped-remotes.md, native-mailbox-relay.md and similar) is product transport and is NOT changed by this item; no transport mechanism changes on guesswork. Agent memories describing SSH lanes are retired separately by their owners.
acceptance: Remove direct-SSH agent procedures: satellite work only through remote sessions, federation and Git branches is done
